name: mirocola-monorepo
description: MiRocola - Salas de rocola y música colaborativa en tiempo real

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build:server: npm install && npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=server && (npm run prisma:push --workspace=server || echo 'DB push skipped') && npm run build --workspace=server
